objectives.description: Add base-mode guard after Check 2 for active_projects presence/type
Guard trip emits one log_fail naming condition/consequence and skips Checks 4-11/--deep
Confirm guard cannot trip for legitimate live specs/state.json

deviations.description: Scope Hypothesis assumed exactly Checks 5,6,7 false-PASS (per research report); live classification found Checks 4 and 8-11 ALSO false-PASS the same way, just silently via their own 2>/dev/null stderr suppression rather than a visible jq error line.
deviations.reason: Confirmed empirically by removing stderr suppression from each check's jq pipeline and re-running against specs/archive/state.json: every one of Checks 4,5,6,7,8,9,10,11 raises 'Cannot iterate over null' and every one still logs PASS. The Phase 2 Goal text already said 'Checks 4-11' throughout (not just 5-7), so the guard's scope (4-11) matches the plan's own stated goal, not the research report's narrower 3-check count.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — guard covers Checks 4-11, confirmed by live classification; the research report's 3-check figure undercounted the silently-suppressed cases)*
